title: Pet
description: Discover the one pet that fits you best, plus independently matched Pet Type and one or two Pet Elements from the real Pet System.

Alligator.label: Alligator
Alligator.description: A patient companion that uses its thick, armored hide and crushing bite to great effect. It's built for power and resilience.

Ant.label: Ant
Ant.description: A fascinating pet demonstrating complex colony behaviors (smarts) and tireless activity, maintaining high energy for foraging.

Anteater.label: Anteater
Anteater.description: Quick with its tongue and highly observant, this pet excels at tricky, precise maneuvers and thoughtful actions.

Badger.label: Badger
Badger.description: Tenacious and scrappy, known for its fierce determination and ability to shrug off damage with its sturdy build.

Bat.label: Bat
Bat.description: Master of the air, it navigates with incredible precision and uses its natural sonar to understand its surroundings perfectly.

Beaver.label: Beaver
Beaver.description: An expert engineer with a knack for building, its sturdy body and keen intellect make it a surprisingly robust companion.

Bee.label: Bee
Bee.description: Speedy flyer and essential pollinator with complex hive behavior and strong flight dexterity.

Beetle.label: Beetle
Beetle.description: Heavily armored insect with a sturdy carapace, providing superior protection and allowing for long periods of sustained activity.

Bison.label: Bison
Bison.description: A massive herbivore with incredible charge power and a thick, durable defense.

BlueTang.label: BlueTang
BlueTang.description: A cheerful and vibrant swimmer known for its lightning-fast movement and sunny, agreeable disposition.

Camel.label: Camel
Camel.description: A companion built for the long haul, using its deep knowledge of navigation and massive endurance to travel tirelessly.

Cardinal.label: Cardinal
Cardinal.description: A remarkably joyful pet, specializing in swift, graceful movement and filling the air with its happy, cheerful presence.

Cat.label: Cat
Cat.description: A calculating and clever hunter, preferring smart, targeted strikes over brute force and always planning its next move.

Cheetah.label: Cheetah
Cheetah.description: The ultimate speedster, relying on explosive dexterity and powerful bursts of attack.

Chicken.label: Chicken
Chicken.description: A simple, contented pet that is always active and constantly foraging with a cheerful, high-spirited nature.

Clownfish.label: Clownfish
Clownfish.description: A famously happy and social pet, demonstrating surprising cleverness in finding safety and forming mutualistic bonds.

Cow.label: Cow
Cow.description: A large, docile grazer with exceptional defensive bulk and peaceful disposition.

Crab.label: Crab
Crab.description: An armored companion with a strong, protective shell and powerful pincers used for a surprisingly strong pinch.

Crow.label: Crow
Crow.description: The smartest bird, exhibiting unmatched intelligence and sturdy, watchful protection.

Deer.label: Deer
Deer.description: Extremely quick and graceful, relying on evasion (DEX) and alertness (INT/ENE) to survive.

Dog.label: Dog
Dog.description: Loyal, trainable intelligence paired with a highly social, happy nature.

Dolphin.label: Dolphin
Dolphin.description: A highly intelligent marine mammal specializing in complex communication and swift aquatic dexterity.

Duck.label: Duck
Duck.description: An adaptable animal with high dexterity across air and water, showing balanced energy.

Eagle.label: Eagle
Eagle.description: A powerful aerial predator with keen eyesight (INT) and lethal hunting attacks.

Elephant.label: Elephant
Elephant.description: The largest land animal, defined by immense defense and crushing attack power.

Emu.label: Emu
Emu.description: A tall, flightless bird known for its fast running dexterity and good endurance.

Fox.label: Fox
Fox.description: A solitary hunter known for its extreme cunning (INT) and targeted attacks.

Frog.label: Frog
Frog.description: A phenomenal jumper with explosive dexterity and high readiness (ENE).

Giraffe.label: Giraffe
Giraffe.description: Tall stature grants defensive advantage and superior field intelligence.

Goat.label: Goat
Goat.description: A hardy animal with a strong headbutt (ATT) and a notoriously playful, happy disposition.

Goose.label: Goose
Goose.description: An aggressive guard bird with a formidable hiss/attack and high, watchful energy.

Gorilla.label: Gorilla
Gorilla.description: A powerful, territorial ape relying on brute strength and formidable defense.

Grizzly.label: Grizzly
Grizzly.description: Pure physical strength defines this pet, which relies on devastating power and thick, durable protection.

Hamster.label: Hamster
Hamster.description: A small, tireless worker, perpetually active and maintaining a constant, simple happiness while on the wheel.

Hedgehog.label: Hedgehog
Hedgehog.description: Defends itself with sharp quills, possessing high energy for nocturnal foraging and durable protection.

Hippo.label: Hippo
Hippo.description: Highly territorial and deceptively fast, combining immense attack power and defensive bulk.

Horse.label: Horse
Horse.description: A swift and powerful partner, specializing in high-speed travel and using its kicks and momentum in battle.

Hummingbird.label: Hummingbird
Hummingbird.description: The ultimate agile pet, specializing in breathtaking aerial stunts and perpetually joyful flight.

Iguana.label: Iguana
Iguana.description: A stoic reptile with great endurance and a powerful tail whip, maintaining a tough, leathery defense.

Jaguar.label: Jaguar
Jaguar.description: A solitary, muscular hunter with powerful attack and lethal stealth (DEX).

Jellyfish.label: Jellyfish
Jellyfish.description: An ancient creature specializing in high endurance with a stinging attack, protected by its fluid body.

Kangaroo.label: Kangaroo
Kangaroo.description: Specializes in powerful leg attacks and leaping dexterity.

Kiwi.label: Kiwi
Kiwi.description: A flightless bird with high-endurance foraging and a sturdy, robust defense.

Koala.label: Koala
Koala.description: The happiest pet, spending most of its time in contented rest, protected by a sturdy grip and high defensive tolerance.

Ladybug.label: Ladybug
Ladybug.description: A perpetually cheerful little friend, constantly active and radiating a simple, enduring contentment.

Lemur.label: Lemur
Lemur.description: Highly social and vocal primate specializing in leaping dexterity and social happiness.

Leopard.label: Leopard
Leopard.description: A balanced and skilled hunter, specializing in graceful stealth (agility) and decisive, powerful attacks.

Lion.label: Lion
Lion.description: The social king of beasts, combining raw attack power and pack happiness.

Llama.label: Llama
Llama.description: A sturdy pack animal, valued for its protective nature (defense) and its generally content, easygoing disposition.

Mantis.label: Mantis
Mantis.description: An ambush master, relying on blindingly fast movements (agility) to execute quick, deadly strikes.

Monkey.label: Monkey
Monkey.description: Incredibly quick and agile in the trees, this pet is highly curious and adept at problem-solving.

Mouse.label: Mouse
Mouse.description: Small, fast, and hard to catch, with excellent evasive ability and a highly adaptable, contented nature.

Octopus.label: Octopus
Octopus.description: The genius of the sea, possessing a fluid, adaptive body and the highest level of strategic, cognitive ability.

Orangutan.label: Orangutan
Orangutan.description: A thoughtful and patient ape, specializing in tool use (smarts) and using its strength to maintain a robust defense.

Orca.label: Orca
Orca.description: The apex marine predator, combining immense strength with complex hunting strategies (intelligence).

Ostrich.label: Ostrich
Ostrich.description: Fastest two-legged runner, using powerful kicks (ATT) and incredible speed (DEX).

Otter.label: Otter
Otter.description: Playful and quick in the water, specializing in hunting intelligence and aquatic dexterity.

Panda.label: Panda
Panda.description: A gentle giant with superb defensive padding and the most peaceful, happy disposition.

Parrot.label: Parrot
Parrot.description: An excellent communicator and mimic, specializing in social intelligence and an incredibly cheerful, talkative disposition.

Peacock.label: Peacock
Peacock.description: Allure and display (HAP) are high, with balanced energy for strutting and a modest defense.

Pelican.label: Pelican
Pelican.description: A sturdy water bird with good flying dexterity and endurance for long fishing trips.

Penguin.label: Penguin
Penguin.description: A hardy, flightless bird with high defense against cold and agile swimming dexterity.

Pig.label: Pig
Pig.description: Surprisingly intelligent animal with a strong rooting attack and contented happiness.

Pigeon.label: Pigeon
Pigeon.description: An excellent flyer, specializing in swift flight dexterity and homing endurance.

Platypus.label: Platypus
Platypus.description: Unique monotreme with venomous spurs (ATT) and high sensory intelligence.

PolarBear.label: PolarBear
PolarBear.description: A massive, powerful Arctic predator with peak strength and defense against the elements.

Pufferfish.label: Pufferfish
Pufferfish.description: Relies on defensive inflation (DEF) and toxic warning (ATT) with high endurance.

Rabbit.label: Rabbit
Rabbit.description: Highly evasive and speedy (DEX) with a social, reproductive happiness.

Raccoon.label: Raccoon
Raccoon.description: A highly adaptable, dexterous scavenger known for its intelligence and 'masked' persona.

Ram.label: Ram
Ram.description: A powerful head-butter with strong attack and defensive horns/skull.

Rat.label: Rat
Rat.description: An adaptable, quick creature specializing in fast movement and survival intelligence.

RedPanda.label: RedPanda
RedPanda.description: A peaceful, arboreal mammal with high happiness and moderate energy for climbing.

Reindeer.label: Reindeer
Reindeer.description: Hardy arctic deer with strong defense and great endurance for long migrations.

Rhino.label: Rhino
Rhino.description: A heavy charger with peak defensive hide and a powerful horn attack.

Salmon.label: Salmon
Salmon.description: Defined by its incredible migratory endurance (ENE) and natural instinct (INT).

Scorpion.label: Scorpion
Scorpion.description: A venomous arachnid with a potent sting (ATT) and hard-shelled defense.

Seahorse.label: Seahorse
Seahorse.description: An unusual fish with excellent camouflage (DEF) and high, calm happiness and energy.

Seal.label: Seal
Seal.description: An intelligent, blubbery mammal with high defense against cold and water.

Shark.label: Shark
Shark.description: The perfect aquatic hunter, combining powerful attack with agile swimming dexterity.

Sheep.label: Sheep
Sheep.description: A flock animal with peak docile happiness and a thick, wooly defense.

Shrimp.label: Shrimp
Shrimp.description: A tiny crustacean with explosive tail flicks (DEX) and high metabolic energy.

Skunk.label: Skunk
Skunk.description: Its pungent spray (ATT) acts as its defense, allowing high energy for nocturnal activity.

Sloth.label: Sloth
Sloth.description: The master of slowness, with peak happiness and natural defensive camouflage.

Snail.label: Snail
Snail.description: Protected by a sturdy shell (DEF) and possessing slow, sustained happiness.

Snake.label: Snake
Snake.description: A cunning hunter, using sharp intelligence to stalk its prey before striking with a powerful, venomous attack.

Spider.label: Spider
Spider.description: A master architect, specializing in complex web design (smarts) and quick, precise eight-legged movement.

Squirrel.label: Squirrel
Squirrel.description: A nimble, playful companion that uses its impressive agility to dart and climb with cheerful enthusiasm.

Starfish.label: Starfish
Starfish.description: A durable, tough marine pet (defense) that maintains a calm, enduring state of simple contentment.

Stingray.label: Stingray
Stingray.description: A graceful swimmer (agility) that can deliver a surprisingly strong and sudden venomous barb attack.

SugarGlider.label: SugarGlider
SugarGlider.description: An aerial acrobat, specializing in beautiful gliding movements and an extremely social, happy nature.

Tiger.label: Tiger
Tiger.description: The epitome of a powerful feline, combining immense strength with stealthy, agile movements.

Toucan.label: Toucan
Toucan.description: A colorful flyer, specializing in swift movement and displaying a high-spirited, cheerful personality.

Turkey.label: Turkey
Turkey.description: A surprisingly robust pet, possessing good stamina for running and a powerful spur/attack.

Turtle.label: Turtle
Turtle.description: The defense champion, featuring an unparalleled shell for protection and high endurance for slow, steady progress.

Walrus.label: Walrus
Walrus.description: A massive marine pet with thick blubber defense and powerful tusks used for high-impact attacks.

Whale.label: Whale
Whale.description: The oceanic giant, specializing in defensive size and complex, thoughtful navigation (smarts).

Wolf.label: Wolf
Wolf.description: A strategic hunter, specializing in coordinated strength and a high degree of survival intellect.

Yak.label: Yak
Yak.description: A robust, hardy animal with maximum defense against the cold and sustained stamina for survival.

Zebra.label: Zebra
Zebra.description: An evasive ungulate, relying on its speed and stripes to confuse predators (agility) and its natural alertness.

Owl.label: Owl
Owl.description: A wise nocturnal hunter, specializing in silent flight and keen observation.

Axolotl.label: Axolotl
Axolotl.description: A regenerative aquatic friend, known for its eternal smile and high spirits.

Centipede.label: Centipede
Centipede.description: A fast, many-legged crawler that strikes with precision and speed.

Firefly.label: Firefly
Firefly.description: A glowing bug that lights the night, bringing joy and wonder.

pet_match.label: Pet Match
pet_match.summary: Composite pet, element, and type result.

questions.prompt: When a challenge appears, what is your first instinct?

answers.text: Strike first and set the pace before anyone can corner you.
Hold your ground, protect your space, and outlast the pressure.
Read the room, think two moves ahead, and choose the cleanest answer.
Keep spirits high and turn the moment into something everyone can handle.

questions.prompt: Pick the terrain where you feel most alive.

answers.text: Open sky, high perches, wind, and fast movement.
Forest paths, dens, fields, caves, and solid ground.
Rivers, reefs, ice, tides, and deep water.
Strange places: ruins, shadows, temples, storms, and dreams.

questions.prompt: What kind of companion would balance you best?

answers.text: A loyal guardian that can take hits and keep watch.
A sharp hunter with bite, courage, and decisive instincts.
A clever scout that notices details others miss.
A bright friend that makes the whole team happier.

questions.prompt: True or false: You would rather win slowly and safely than risk everything on one explosive move.

answers.text: True
False

questions.prompt: Choose your favorite kind of pet energy.

answers.text: Calm, sturdy, dependable, and hard to shake.
Wild, intense, competitive, and fearless.
Quick, graceful, playful, and impossible to pin down.
Odd, mystical, observant, and secretly brilliant.

questions.prompt: What would your pet be best known for?

answers.text: Powerful attacks and dramatic finishes.
Defensive bulk and refusing to go down.
Problem solving, tricks, memory, and planning.
Speed, dodges, precision, and clean escapes.

questions.prompt: Which element calls to you most?

answers.text: Fire, lightning, combat, and momentum.
Water, ice, patience, and emotional flow.
Nature, stone, endurance, and steady growth.
Magic, holy light, psychic force, and shadow.

questions.prompt: Your ideal pet adventure is:

answers.text: A dungeon crawl where your pet breaks through enemies.
A rescue mission where your pet protects the vulnerable.
A scouting mission full of puzzles, traps, and hidden paths.
A long expedition where endurance and morale matter most.

questions.prompt: True or false: A pet should be more clever than strong.

answers.text: True
False

questions.prompt: How should your pet react to danger?

answers.text: Charge in and end it fast.
Shield others and absorb the hit.
Slip away, reposition, and strike precisely.
Confuse the threat with tricks or strange power.

questions.prompt: Pick the vibe closest to your personality.

answers.text: Gentle, loyal, warm, and community-minded.
Independent, sharp, quiet, and strategic.
Restless, fast, curious, and kinetic.
Stubborn, brave, intense, and protective.

questions.prompt: Which stat would you max first in a pet build?

answers.text: ATT: I want decisive damage.
DEF: I want reliable survival.
INT: I want smart plays and skill value.
DEX: I want speed, evasion, and precision.

questions.prompt: Choose a second priority.

answers.text: HAP: a happy pet is a strong pet.
ENE: I want stamina for long runs.
A balanced attack/defense split.
A balanced mind/speed split.

questions.prompt: True or false: You would pick a weird, rare-fitting pet over a traditionally powerful one.

answers.text: True
False

questions.prompt: Which pet behavior sounds most charming?

answers.text: Bringing gifts, cheering people up, and staying close.
Training hard, sparring, and showing off power.
Watching silently, solving things, and acting at the perfect moment.
Zooming around, exploring every corner, and never sitting still.

questions.prompt: Finally, what should your pet feel like when people see it?

answers.text: Noble and radiant.
Dark and intimidating.
Natural and peaceful.
Ancient and elemental.

questions.prompt: What would your pet do during downtime?

answers.text: Nap nearby, accept affection, and keep the room peaceful.
Patrol the edges, watch exits, and notice every sound.
Practice attacks, chase things, and test its strength.
Explore water, vents, rafters, tunnels, or anywhere hard to reach.

questions.prompt: Which bond sounds most natural between you and your pet?

answers.text: A loyal partner that stays close and trusts routines.
A clever equal that needs respect and mental stimulation.
A fierce ally that wants challenge, action, and victory.
A strange little soul that chooses you, not the other way around.

questions.prompt: Which body style fits your ideal companion?

answers.text: Compact, quick, sneaky, and hard to catch.
Large, sturdy, grounded, and reassuring.
Winged, graceful, bright, or watchful from above.
Aquatic, smooth, flowing, strange, or deep-sea calm.

questions.prompt: True or false: Your perfect pet should be emotionally expressive and visibly happy.

answers.text: True
False

questions.prompt: If your pet had a signature move, it would be:

answers.text: A crushing bite, tackle, claw strike, sting, or horn charge.
A shell guard, thick hide, herd wall, burrow, or defensive brace.
A sonar pulse, clever trick, illusion, or precise distraction.
A sprint, dive, current ride, wing dodge, or lightning-fast escape.

questions.prompt: Which weakness would you tolerate in your pet?

answers.text: Not the fastest, as long as it is sturdy and loyal.
Not the toughest, as long as it is fast and clever.
Not the friendliest, as long as it is powerful and focused.
Not the strongest, as long as it is cheerful and energizing.

questions.prompt: Which environment should your pet be able to survive best?

answers.text: Dry heat, open plains, rough stone, or desert travel.
Cold, ice, deep water, storms, or slippery terrain.
Tall trees, cliffs, wind, rooftops, or wide sky.
Dark ruins, haunted places, temples, or magical spaces.

questions.prompt: A stranger meets your pet. What do they notice first?

answers.text: Its presence: strong, bold, and impossible to ignore.
Its eyes: aware, calculating, and weirdly human.
Its movement: quick, elegant, and almost weightless.
Its warmth: friendly, gentle, and easy to trust.

questions.prompt: True or false: Your pet should be built more for long adventures than short bursts.

answers.text: True
False

questions.prompt: Pick the pet archetype you trust most.

answers.text: Guardian: durable, protective, patient.
Hunter: sharp, strong, decisive.
Trickster: smart, slippery, surprising.
Companion: happy, steady, energizing.

questions.prompt: Which element pairing feels most like your pet?

answers.text: Fire + Fighting: bold force and direct action.
Water + Ice: adaptable, calm, and controlled.
Air + Electric: quick, bright, and restless.
Magic + Psychic: strange, clever, and intuitive.

questions.prompt: Last filter: what should your perfect pet help you become?

answers.text: Braver and more willing to act.
Calmer, safer, and more grounded.
Sharper, wiser, and harder to fool.
Freer, lighter, and more adventurous.

questions.prompt: Type filter: how should your pet move through the world?

answers.text: On paws, claws, hooves, or steady legs across solid ground.
Through the air: gliding, hovering, swooping, or perching high.
Through water: swimming, diving, floating, or riding currents.
Anywhere it wants, but you picture its main freedom as motion itself.

questions.prompt: Type filter: where would your pet choose to sleep?

answers.text: A den, burrow, nest on the ground, stable, cave, or cozy room.
A branch, roof beam, cliff ledge, tower, or suspended perch.
A pond, reef, riverbank, tide pool, ice shelf, or damp hideaway.
It would sleep wherever you are, habitat rules be ignored.

questions.prompt: Type filter: in a chase scene, your pet wins by:

answers.text: Digging in, cutting corners, and using terrain.
Taking vertical space and escaping above the problem.
Diving under, slipping through water, or vanishing below the surface.
Switching routes so unpredictably that nobody can read it.

questions.prompt: Type filter: choose the travel fantasy you like most.

answers.text: Crossing forests, deserts, mountains, fields, and old roads.
Riding wind, clouds, rooftops, moonlight, and open sky.
Following rivers, reefs, storms, glaciers, and deep ocean paths.
Traveling between all three because the journey matters more than the route.

questions.prompt: Element filter: what kind of power feels most natural?

answers.text: A clean, simple, grounded power that works anywhere.
A bright, burning, aggressive power that pushes forward.
A flowing, adaptive power that can soothe or overwhelm.
A strange, unseen power that bends rules and perception.

questions.prompt: Element filter: pick the weather around your pet.

answers.text: Clear sun, warm sparks, heat shimmer, or wildfire glow.
Rain, fog, tides, snow, frost, or quiet cold.
Wind, lightning, pressure shifts, and charged air.
Stillness, shadows, grave-light, or impossible colors.

questions.prompt: Element filter: what should your pet protect?

answers.text: Life, growth, gardens, comfort, and recovery.
Justice, courage, vows, and people who need hope.
Secrets, thresholds, endings, and forbidden places.
Knowledge, dreams, memories, and hidden patterns.

questions.prompt: Element filter: choose a battle aura.

answers.text: Stone armor, heavy impact, and unbreakable stance.
Martial focus, raw courage, and close-range pressure.
Crackling speed, sudden shocks, and charged reflexes.
Cold control, frozen timing, and punishing patience.

questions.prompt: Element filter: choose the color palette you imagine.

answers.text: Gold, white, sunrise, and clean light.
Green, moss, flowers, vines, and living wood.
Black, violet, bone, smoke, and moonlit shadow.
Blue, teal, silver, glass, and deep current.

questions.prompt: Element filter: if your pet had a rare second element, it would come from:

answers.text: Discipline and combat spirit.
Mystery and spellcraft.
Nature and endurance.
Storm and motion.

questions.prompt: Pet filter: what problem should your pet solve best?

answers.text: Breaking through obstacles by force.
Keeping everyone safe under pressure.
Understanding confusing situations quickly.
Moving precisely when timing matters.

questions.prompt: Pet filter: what emotional role should it play?

answers.text: Joy-bringer: it makes bad days lighter.
Endurance partner: it keeps going when things get long.
Protector: it makes you feel safe.
Motivator: it pushes you to act.

questions.prompt: Pet filter: which flaw is most acceptable?

answers.text: Low patience, if it has strong instincts.
Low speed, if it is sturdy.
Low raw power, if it is brilliant.
Low seriousness, if it brings happiness.

questions.prompt: Pet filter: your final instinct says the pet should be:

answers.text: Strong first.
Tough first.
Smart first.
Fast or joyful first.

questions.prompt: Type final filter: if your pet ignored biology and chose a form of freedom, it would choose:

answers.text: Grounded freedom: running, climbing, digging, standing firm.
Sky freedom: flying, floating, gliding, hovering, perching.
Water freedom: swimming, diving, drifting, flowing, surfacing.

questions.prompt: Type final filter: your pet's battle positioning should be:

answers.text: Frontline and grounded, controlling space directly.
Above the fight, using angles and elevation.
Fluid and hard to pin down, using waterlike movement.

questions.prompt: Type final filter: choose the symbol that feels most like your pet.

answers.text: Footprints in earth.
A silhouette against the sky.
Ripples on water.

questions.prompt: Element final filter: choose the strongest spiritual flavor.

answers.text: Basic: pure, adaptable, simple, and universal.
Holy: radiant, protective, oath-bound, hopeful.
Necro: shadowed, eerie, taboo, death-touched.
Magic or Psychic: arcane, mental, dreamlike, and precise.

questions.prompt: Element final filter: choose the strongest physical flavor.

answers.text: Fire and Fighting: heat, courage, force.
Water and Ice: flow, patience, control.
Plant and Rock: growth, endurance, roots.
Air and Electric: speed, charge, motion.

questions.prompt: Element final filter: if your pet had two elements, how should the pair feel?

answers.text: Basic alone: no second element, just clean universal power.
Light and shadow in one companion.
Spell and mind woven together.
Nature and water growing together.

questions.prompt: Pet final filter: what kind of defense feels most like your companion?

answers.text: A small shell, gentle patience, and quiet contentment.
A massive shell, ancient stamina, and fortress-like endurance.
Thick hide, heavy body, and raw physical bulk.
Avoiding hits through speed instead of absorbing them.

questions.prompt: Pet final filter: choose its natural pace.

answers.text: Slow, sweet, persistent, and surprisingly hard to bother.
Slow, ancient, tanky, and built for long survival.
Fast, explosive, and always in motion.
Still, watchful, and mentally sharp.

scoringNote: Pet species, element(s), and type are weighted independently: pet uses stat-profile matching, elements use element-only questions, and type uses type-only questions.
